statement: AMD disclosed in a Form 8-K that it agreed on September 26, 2026 to acquire all equity interests in World Labs Technologies for approximately $8.2 billion, paid entirely in AMD common stock.
why: An all-stock acquisition of this size is AMD spending balance-sheet capacity to broaden its AI capability stack, which strengthens the credibility of the main alternative to NVIDIA in merchant accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Consolidating an AI technology company into AMD deepens the non-NVIDIA accelerator and software offering available to buyers, widening alternative supply in the merchant-GPU market.

evidence.excerpt: all of the equity interests in World Labs Technologies, Inc.
in shares of the Company's common stock, par value $0.01 per share.

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: AMD's own Form 8-K filed with the SEC and signed by its General Counsel.

dispersion: Purchase price about $8.2 billion; final share count to be set by a ten-trading-day volume-weighted average price before closing.
